title: Norman Brownlee
summary: Brief talk about Norman Brownlee, now in Pensacola.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Did you ever hear Brownlee's band? Norman Brownlee?

Norman Brownlee? No. No, in fact, Norman Brownlee was at the same session that I told you about at Paul Merez's house. He was out there that night. Yes, I heard Brownlee. Brownlee's band. In fact, several times, I can't say that I can recall anything definite about it or as to what, how good it was or anything like that.
I thought he might have been a piano player that you listened to us.
Well, I believe Norman did play piano, didn't he?
Yes, he was a piano player.
Did he play something else too besides piano? Did he play?
He played bass too, did he?
I don't know whether he played it here, but he plays bass fiddle now too.
He's in Pensacola? He's in Pensacola.

He's in Pensacola. He's in Pensacola. Insurance, I think. He was president of the local, but he's still playing piano. Still playing piano. I remember him and I saw him a couple years ago. He plays fine. Still plays fine. We were often stomping.
